title: ገጠር - Geter
logline: Growing up side by side with my brother in the green Ethiopian countryside, in a home that always had coffee and was never empty.
audience: Classmates and peers watching together in class, and Ethiopians who grew up in rural places and miss them
intent: Warmth, reflection and nostalgia: viewers who grew up in the countryside should feel their own childhood home again
